new_results.statement: For independent density-<=1 X,Y,Z and any invertible symmetric 3x3 physical quadratic block M with one zero diagonal pivot, arbitrary affine drift is allowed and ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3*2^(2/3)|det M|^(-1/3). The same holds conditionally inside arbitrary ambient dimension with arbitrary outside couplings.

For a heavy isotropic rank-three row u_i=sqrt(c)e, c>1/2, transverse determinant weights omega_jk=det(w_j,w_k)^2 sum to one and |det A[{i,j,k}]|=c|det Lambda|omega_jk. Hence any atom omega_jk>0 yields density cap 3*2^(2/3)[c|det Lambda|omega_jk]^(-1/3).

Inside an exact rank-three target family with true original-product orthogonal projection, fragmented density-one inputs make the projected-leakage conditional cost E[H(T)^(2/3)] grow at least [3*2^(2/3)/4](M-1)M^(-1/3). Conditioning first on projected T is therefore not a universal completion route. The family itself remains uniformly bounded by original-coordinate conditioning.
